_comment: Edit this file to change which managers get tracked.
label    - what shows up in your spreadsheet. Anything you want.
search   - the name used to look up the filer on SEC EDGAR.
Should be close to the registered adviser name.
cik      - leave as null the first time. Run with --save-ciks and
the script fills this in for you. Once filled, lookups
are skipped and runs get faster and more deterministic.
enabled  - set false to skip without deleting the entry.
To add a fund: copy any block, change label/search, set cik to null,

funds.label: Tiger Global
funds.note: Chase Coleman. The original cub, Julian Robertson seed.
